description: WRITE. Purge one URL from the CDN cache. A URL ending in '/' purges everything under it unless exact_path is true; a '*' wildcard is also accepted. The CDN refetches from the origin. bunny.net: POST /purge.

async.description: Return immediately instead of waiting for the purge to finish.

exact_path.description: For a URL ending in '/', purge only that exact path.

url.description: The CDN URL to purge, e.g. https://myzone.b-cdn.net/css/site.css.

name: bunny_purge_url
title: Purge a URL from cache
